title: I wish you fix the time counting bug
body:
This app is great overall and probably the best but I wish you fix the time counting bug. Sometimes what’s seen on the screen and actual time counting in app is getting mixed up. Sometimes it pauses by itself and I’m having to add manually. And also I wish when changing the style of the habit, count or hours, it wasn’t sent to archive but anyway overall great app but please fix that time bug. And make it manipulatable through dynamic island or through the locked screen.

Also changing from hour counting to minute counting shouldn’t force to delete the previous data.
author: FurkanTopal

title: Im in love with this app😚💓
body: Its great for keeping or making habits even whitout a premium. Im still recommending to buy a premium tho its really worth it!
author: muumimamma💓

title: Not good
body: The idea is nice, but I could not even set it up. The added habits did not show on front page and the habits that a friend shared did not come through. I tried to see what's wrong for hours but could not figure out what was wrong, I deleted it soon after downloading. Also, the app starts lagging even though the phone itself is fine.
author: kkeiuu

title: Love it!
body: The app is really great for starting new habits and getting rid of the bad ones! I love the already made habit tracker options and also love that you can make custom ones! I like how you can choose a color and an icon for each habit to make it unique. I also really appreciate the streak and the diagram options because it really shows the progression and also motivates me! Overall the app is really worth it and I really recommend it for improving yourself!

title: I am so productive.
body: Your app is very good. I get positive affirmation everytime i complete a habit. The day streak is my favourite. Doing a habit every day and seeing the count go up is soo useful. I just wish I could do even more. I have become so productive, because I am seeing the goal and I get constant reminders to do it.

title: The best and most aesthetically pleasing
body:
Thank you for a most thorough and accessible habit tracking application. The app is very efficient, as well as super beautiful and customizable to one’s needs. 

I tried 10+ various habit trackers and this is the one I’ve chosen and used for nearly a year now, with much success in instilling new healthy habits.
